paragraphs: Sergeant Laboratories sells AristotleK12, an EdTech product for managing student technology. The platform groups filtering, asset reporting, student behavior analytics and classroom management tools under what the site calls a single pane of glass. Filtering integrates with Google Admin Console, Active Directory, or SIS, and can be deployed on or off campus.

Geolocation finds student devices without placing a device in lost or stolen mode. Asset reporting inventories software, hardware and web application assets for year-end audits and spending analysis. Alerts notify staff of inappropriate or unsafe behavior on school-issued devices.

Classroom tools integrate with a Student Information System so educators are not adjusting rosters or class schedules. The pages state that Sergeant Laboratories signs Data Privacy Agreements from school districts and states, and that it does not view, sell, store or share student information.

quote.text: Everything you need under a single pane of glass. One platform. One price.
